description: This file provides functions for creating Date objects from individual date and time components, with adjustments for years in the 0-99 range to avoid JavaScript's default behavior of remapping these to 1900-1999.

methods.name: createDate(y, m, d, h, M, s, ms)
methods.description: Creates a Date object from provided year, month, day, hour, minute, second, millisecond values, adjusting the year if it is in the range 0-99.

methods.name: createUTCDate(y)
methods.description: Creates a UTC Date object from provided date components, adjusting the year if it is in the range 0-99.

calls: new Date(y, m, d, h, M, s, ms)

ctags.name: createDate
ctags.pattern: /^export function createDate (y, m, d, h, M, s, ms) {$/
ctags.signature: (y, m, d, h, M, s, ms)
